Quantification was performed by comparing intensities between the biotin-sample and a biotin-alkene negative control (LFQ/TIC).

scope: Biotin-isofalcarintriol (structure 15, for synthesis see Supplementary Figs. 5, 6) was used in two independent pulldown assays with mass spectrometric analysis in HepG2 and HEK293 cells
The freshly prepared bead-compound mix was mixed with the protein supernatant and incubated another 4 h at 4 °C on an end-over-end rotator.
After this incubation time, the beads were washed 5 times with lysis buffer without protease inhibitor and without detergent.
proteins on beads were eluted and digested by adding 20 μl 50 mM Tris-HCl buffer (pH 8.0) supplemented with 2 M urea, 5 mM DTT and 100 ng Sequencing Grade Trypsin

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is an affinity purification (biotin-pulldown) to identify interaction partners of the synthetic probe biotin-isofalcarintriol compared to a biotin-alkene control. While the broader study involves genetic perturbations (NRF2 KO) and disease models (Alzheimer's/Huntington's), these were not the primary variables of the MS-analyzed samples described in the Biotin Pulldowns and Mass Spectrometry section.
